security_note: Identity, owner, policy, audience and authorization context are NOT model-supplied tool arguments. Tool annotations are hints, not enforcement. Validate cross-field time constraints server-side.

tools.name: prepare_day_brief
tools.description: Prepare a day plan using sources the owner connected to EARSHOT. Return only explicitly public facts. Full plan and actual private processing status remain in the authenticated owner inbox. Does not change external calendars.

timezone.description: Validated IANA timezone, not a guessed numeric offset.

request_key.description: Retry-stable request key. Server binds dedupe to authenticated owner and rejects conflicting reuse.

continuation_ref.description: Optional. The request_ref of an in-progress chunked brief: returns the next chunk ('next' followup). Re-plans remaining items against fresh belief.

speak.description: The exact utterance for the room. Render verbatim: never elaborate, summarize, reorder, or append. This is the ONLY room-facing text.

speak_policy.description: How the host must render `speak`. The only legal value.

mode.description: Room-known mode: 'cover' iff a non-owner listener is in the credible audience. Never a secret.

followups.description: Constant followup affordances. 'next' continues a chunked brief.

screen_depth.description: Minimum planned spoken depth across spoken items (0 when nothing spoken). Never above planned depth.

request_ref.description: Opaque EARSHOT request reference; not authorization. For briefs, doubles as the continuation ref.

earshot/table_version.description: Disclosure-table version. Constant in fixture; never content-derived.
